app.name: Thaheen
app.tagline: An education platform that brings your courses and video lessons together in one place, in Arabic and English.

home.heroTitle: Start your learning journey with Thaheen
home.heroSubtitle: Video courses organized into sequential lessons, with your progress saved automatically right where you left off.
home.featureVideoDesc: Watch your lessons in great quality with full control over speed and seeking.
home.featureProgressDesc: We save where you left off and show your completion percentage for every course.
home.featureSequentialDesc: Lessons unlock in order so your understanding builds step by step.
home.featureBilingualDesc: The platform's interface and course content are fully available in both languages.
